name: Toho Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Toho Gas Co., Ltd. engages in the gas, LPG and other energy, electric power, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the extraction and trade of natural gas and other energy resources; sale of coke, tar products, petroleum products, paving materials, automobiles, daily necessities, food, and beverages; design, supervision, and construction of civil engineering, architectural, electrical, plumbing, and machinery installation works; and sale, leasing, and management of real estate.
